title: (Internal) Applying a Credit Card Statement Credit
summary: Covers how support agents apply a credit card statement credit using tools unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and apply_statement_credit_8472. Requires user_id, credit_card_account_id, a positive dollar amount (e.g., 25.00), and a reason limited to a fixed set; then confirms it posts as a negative transaction and reduces the statement balance.
faqs: How do I apply a statement credit to a customer’s credit card account?
What tool name and steps do I use (unlock then call apply_statement_credit_8472)?
What arguments are required (user_id, credit_card_account_id, amount, reason)?
What are the allowed reason values for the statement credit?
How do I verify the statement credit applied correctly?
Where do I find the credit_card_account_id for a user? (Refers to get_credit_card_accounts_by_user)
